summary: Mobile UX optimization frontend testing at 390x844, 375x812 and 1920x800 (desktop sanity). PASS: no horizontal overflow on ANY of 15 public pages (/, /about, /leadership, /initiatives, /initiatives/business-elevation-lab, /donate, /events, /sessions, /gallery, /volunteer, /contact, /transparency, /stories, /membership, /members) nor on /members portal — doc.scrollWidth equals innerWidth (390 or 375) everywhere; desktop 1920 also no regression. Header hamburger [aria-label='Open menu'] renders 46x46 (>=44 tap target), opens a slide-out menu containing nav + 'Donate Now' CTA. Donate pill in header on mobile: one visible at 92x36 (clearly rendered — screenshot confirms); a second hidden-on-mobile desktop variant (w=0) exists but is intentionally hidden via responsive classes. Member Portal (cookie session_token=mem_tok_a, qa_mem_a member_status=active role=member): [data-testid='portal-tabbar'] is ONE row (rows=1), overflow-x:auto, scrollWidth=1287 > clientWidth=348 (scrollable), 11 tabs render in a single horizontally scrollable strip (Announcements, Discussion, Prayer, Votes, My Dues, Directory, Spotlights, Photos, Minutes, Bylaws, My Profile). Clicking Prayer/My Dues/Directory/Photos/My Profile switches content with NO horizontal overflow. Forms font-size: /donate, /contact, /volunteer, program signup (#join on /initiatives/business-elevation-lab) — ALL inputs/selects/textareas compute >=16px (prevents iOS zoom). Email fields have autoComplete='email'. (/membership mobile page has 0 form inputs — apply flow is a separate page/modal; not tested here.) Images: home hero at top=650, w=350x420 has fetchpriority='high' and NO loading attr (correct — not lazy). All below-the-fold images (leader portraits at top=4535, second hero at top=1903) have loading='lazy'. Only one non-lazy image below the fold = site logo footer repeat (acceptable, tiny file). Sessions /sessions on mobile defaults to List view (data-testid='sessions-view-list' is the active/filled pill — bg-[#B4247E] class), Calendar pill still available next to it. Gallery lightbox on mobile: tap [data-testid='gallery-item-0'] opens [data-testid='gallery-lightbox']; swipe left (touchstart x=300 → touchend x=100, dx=-200) advances to next photo (src changed); [data-testid='gallery-lightbox-next'] (56x56) advances; [data-testid='gallery-lightbox-prev'] (56x56); [data-testid='gallery-lightbox-close'] (32x32) closes. Leadership bio popup on mobile: clicking a leader opens [data-testid='leader-modal'] with class 'items-end md:items-center' → bottom sheet on mobile; close (X), prev (Tiggy), next (Yeama), '1 / 6' counter all render. Backend not tested (frontend-only pass). QA users torn down (qa_members.py down executed).

ui_bugs.issue:
Visible text computes to fontSize=11.52px (<12px) on mobile — violates task rule 'no visible text computes below 12px'. Found on EVERY tested page. Examples on /:

'Welcome to Caring Sisters Club', 'Our Mission', 'The Power of our Sisterhood', 'Meet our leaders', 'Voices of the Sisterhood'; footer

'Explore', 'Get Involved', 'Contact'. Same 11.52px eyebrow pattern repeats on /about, /leadership, /initiatives, /donate, /events, /sessions, /gallery, /volunteer, /contact, /transparency, /stories, /membership, /members. Likely source: Tailwind text-xs (0.75rem=12px) with letter-spacing reducing effective render below 12 OR a text-[11.5px] utility. Fix: bump eyebrow/kicker and footer section-headings to >=12px on mobile (e.g., text-[12px] or text-xs with min-font-size override in the mobile polish block of index.css).

6 of 26 footer <a> links render with height < 30px on mobile 390x844 (min=18.75px). Task requires 'approx >= 30px tall' for footer links on mobile. Likely the social-icon anchors or compact bottom-row legal links. Add py-1.5/py-2 to those anchors or increase line-height within the mobile polish block.
[data-testid='gallery-lightbox-close'] is 32x32px — below iOS/Android 44px recommended tap target. Prev/Next are 56x56 (good). Consider padding the X button to >=44x44 on mobile.

issues: Eyebrow labels at 11.52px feel small on mobile; consider 12-13px

action_items: Bump eyebrow/kicker text and footer section <h4> headings to >=12px (ideally 12-13px) on mobile — currently 11.52px, violates task spec.
Enlarge the 6 footer link tap targets that render under 30px tall on mobile (add vertical padding or increase line-height in mobile polish CSS).
Optionally bump [data-testid='gallery-lightbox-close'] padding so its tap target is ≥44x44 on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile polish block in index.css successfully resolves horizontal overflow and achieves 16px inputs — great. Remaining tweaks are two small CSS additions (min font-size for eyebrows/footer-headings, footer link padding).
Members portal tabbar scroll strip works great — consider adding a subtle right-edge gradient fade to hint there are more tabs offscreen.
Gallery lightbox swipe implementation (touchstart/touchend with 50px threshold) works reliably; stopPropagation on inner content prevents accidental close on image tap — well done.
Leadership modal uses items-end md:items-center for bottom-sheet pattern — proper responsive technique.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (12 of 13 checks pass; tiny-text + footer-tap-target are the two misses)

test_credentials: Member: cookie session_token=mem_tok_a on caring-sisters-clone.preview.emergentagent.com with qa_mem_a role=member member_status=active. Cleaned up (qa_members.py down).
seed_data_creation: qa_mem_a / qa_mem_b users were created via qa_members.py up and manually promoted to member_status=active, role=member; torn down post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All overflow/forms/images/lightbox/leader-modal/sessions-default/portal-tabbar mobile checks are green. The only concrete remaining mobile UX issues are (1) 11.52px eyebrow/kicker labels + footer <h4> headings across all pages (needs >=12px) and (2) 6/26 footer links under 30px tall on mobile (needs ~>=30px). Lightbox close at 32px is borderline — not critical. Member cookie name is 'session_token' (not 'mem_tok_a' as literal — mem_tok_a is the VALUE). Promotion step `db.users.update_one({'user_id':'qa_mem_a'},{'\$set':{'member_status':'active','role':'member'}})` is required after qa_members.py up because the script seeds role='pending'.
